card.name: Inside ivacaftor and similar drug names
card.fires_on: The piece "iv" in the middle of the drug name ivacaftor (e.g. lumacaftor/ivacaftor), and a few other spots such as "fl" before uticasone or punctuation after dose or trial details.

modes.label: ivacaftor name piece
modes.description: The "iv" that begins ivacaftor after a slash or a word like of, mg, or increased.
modes.example: The highest repeated dose was lumacaftor 1000 mg once daily/<<iv>>acaftor 450 mg

modes.label: Other drug-name or trial text
modes.description: The start of fluticasone or a comma or closing parenthesis in cardiovascular trial descriptions.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of TRELEGY ELLIPTA for maintenance treatment of COPD is<< fl>>uticasone furoate 1

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like vo and run, and away from other word endings, so no clear drug-name effect.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the drug name ivacaftor, mostly in cystic fibrosis labels.
